scripts.dev: concurrently -n modal,web -c blue,green "npm run modal:serve" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.modal:serve: cd apps/api && uv run python -m modal serve modal_app.py
scripts.modal:deploy: cd apps/api && uv run python -m modal deploy modal_app.py
scripts.sim:cms: cd apps/api && uv run python -m modal run modal_cms_app.py --case-zip ../../tasks/cms/sample_case.zip --form-pdf ../../tasks/cms/blank/i-140.pdf
